Clause2 H2A_OR_H2B (at least one must be decision-valid; both attempted, either suffices): H2A FULL-DOM: If full-DOM n>=20 cap-removed locatable 21-82 enumeration executed with NC3 same-cardinality role-subset null (1000 perms) and F_full bootstrap 95% CI entirely outside 80% (ci_upper<0.80 => FALSIFIED plateau confirmed still closes debate; ci_lower>0.80 => SURVIVES truncation-artifact) with excess vs NC3 >=0.20 and non-overlapping CIs then H2A = SURVIVES (ranking agreement decided; FALSIFIED plateau counts as decision-valid closure per Director). H2B CAP HOLDOUT: If CAP website-holdout spec-compliant TF-IDF/k-means train-only (k as frozen, 1000 shuffles, 2000 bootstraps, k/2,2k) executed on verified website-split (avg 3 sites/task 7 actions/task) and overlap>=0.15 AND excess>=0.10 AND overlap>shuffle_p95 AND bootstrap CI lower > threshold+0.05 AND PC2 recurrence >=1 cluster in >=10 tasks across >=3 sites then H2B = SURVIVES; if any threshold fails => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING at this granularity; if split not website-based or site multiplicity unverified => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Clause3 OVERALL: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires Clause1 SURVIVES AND (H2A SURVIVES-decided OR H2B SURVIVES) with Stagehand baseline reported (hit_rate/latency/tokens).
